authoritative_sources.note: The GrandQC depositor record defines MPP20 contents, expert masks, scale, file checksums, and non-commercial academic terms.
The AIRAQc paper identifies the 50 H&E TCGA slides, manual artifact annotations, and linked public annotation release. Paper terms do not expand the annotation release rights.
The GDC policy is the authority for open-data acknowledgement and re-identification restrictions.

mappings.note: Keep GrandQC and AIRAQc as two source products, one per third-party dataset.
Use the source record ID as the table join key.
Reference the owning source product. The slide-quality product must not copy image bytes.
Reference source-owned masks and annotations. They are not new Pathologize artifacts.
Keep publisher fields opaque instead of renaming them as Pathologize facts.
Use the existing value for both axes and retain its source evidence.
Record H&E as a Pathologize interpretation while source payloads retain publisher terms.
AIRAQc records carry scanner fields. GrandQC records must mark missing scanner fields as not reported.
Point at a source annotation artifact. Only a newly generated Pathologize mask may become a derived artifact.
